WITH scan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s.questregistry,
        s.arcref,
        sp.scanresolmm,
        sp.pointdense,
        sp.coverpct,
        sp.lappct,
        sp.noisedb,
        -- SRI = log10(scanresolmm * 1000) / log10(pointdense) * 5
        (LOG(sp.scanresolmm * 1000) / LOG(10)) / (LOG(sp.pointdense) / LOG(10)) * 5 AS sri,
        -- SCE = (coverpct * (1 + lappct/100 * (1 - coverpct/100))) / 100
        (sp.coverpct * (1.0 + sp.lappct / 100.0 * (1.0 - sp.coverpct / 100.0)) / 100.0) AS sce
    FROM scans s
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON s.arcref = sp.arcref AND s.crewref = sp.crewref
),
scan_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        questregistry,
        arcref,
        sri,
        sce,
        noisedb,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY arcref ORDER BY 
            POWER(10.0 / NULLIF(sri, 0), 1.5) * (sce) * POWER(1.0 - noisedb / 30.0, 2) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM scan_data
)
